text:
Jules: late-night micro-poll: what should be the official team soundtrack for the long weekend binge? options: A) dreamy film score B) lo-fi hiphop C) shoegaze D) 90s indie. quick votes pls. :ballot_box:
Mateo: B) for focus vibes during the opening credits.
Priya: A) film score wins for me. rec: Jonny Greenwood's early solo stuff.
Ethan: D) 90s indie. always D. recommended single: 'Fade Into You' live version.
Neda: C) shoegaze. also incoming rec: short graphic novel instead of another show? anyone read 'My Favorite Thing Is Monsters'? perfect late-night one-sitting.
Jules: @Neda adding that to my queue. also tally: A:1 B:1 C:1 D:1 looks like we need a tiebreaker.
Mateo: tiebreaker rule: whoever posts the most compact rec wins. 1 sentence. go.
Priya: film score pick: 'There Will Be Blood' OST - unsettling and gorgeous.
Ethan: 1-sentence indie rec: 'Last Night I Dreamt I Was a Butterfly' playlist + candle.
Neda: graphic novel 1-liner: 'My Favorite Thing Is Monsters' 40s if you like eerie childhood plots + sharp illustration.
Jules: OK majority rule: shuffle of A and C, so film score + shoegaze. playlist-bot: can you make a temporary mix? :pray:
playlist-bot: created 'Team Late Night Mix' and added: Jonny Greenwood - "Prospectors Arrive", My Bloody Valentine - "Only Shallow", selected tracks from 'There Will Be Blood' OST. link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2example
Mateo: perfect. micro-challenge: pick one short comfort read to pair with 2 songs from the playlist. I'll start: 'The Lover's Dictionary' (novella) + My Bloody Valentine - 'When You Sleep'.
Priya: 'The Vegetarian' (short-ish) + Greenwood - "Jubilee".
Ethan: 'Blankets' (graphic memoir) + MBV - 'Sometimes'.
Neda: 'My Favorite Thing Is Monsters' + Greenwood - "Prospectors Arrive".
Jules: love it. promise to test all combos this weekend and report back with one line verdict each. night team. :crescent_moon:
Priya: night! low-key excited to be carried off by film score + shoegaze.
playlist-bot: added Mateo's and Priya's pairings to 'Team Late Night Mix' as separate segments. :robot_face:
